title: Short-Video Ecom Donggan Yinfu Raises ¥5M Angel Led by Weimi Group
summary: On Sep 18, 2022, Wuhan Donggan Yinfu (动感音符) closed a ¥5M angel led by Guangdong Weimi Group (唯觅集团) for core tech, short-video/livestream team scale, and brand/channel partnerships. Founded 2021; short-video ecom, livestream ecom, and feed-ad ops. Since H2’22 monthly GMV +50%+.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · September 23, 2022

On Sep 18, 2022, Wuhan Donggan Yinfu (动感音符) closed a ¥5M angel led by Guangdong Weimi Group (唯觅集团) for core tech, short-video/livestream team scale, and brand/channel partnerships. Founded 2021; short-video ecom, livestream ecom, and feed-ad ops. Since H2’22 monthly GMV +50%+. CEO ex-Tencent / Hubei internet listed-co ops (10y+); co-founder Huang Xun: interest-commerce needs industrializable content quality. Douyin as primary runway.

— END —
